BOSASA

By: Nicky Troll | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
After 9 days of explosive state capture testimony exposing corruption and bribery at Bosasa – we exclusive speak to the corrupted whistle-blower Angelo Agrizzi and an unexpected source set to discr

Unique Selling Point:
BIG NEWS STORY
NO ONE HAS EXCLUSIVE STI DOWN WITH AGRIZZI
AND ABSOLUTELY NO ONE HAS THE SOURCE PEET VENTER – THIS IS THE FIRST TIME HE WILL SPEAKOUT AGAINST AGRIZZI


Further information:
Explosive testimony at the Zondo Commission on State Capture has lifted the lid on gross corruption & bribery lining the palms of influential politicians while filling the coffers of Bosasa with dodgy tenders and skirting around any kind of investigation that might expose the corporate’s unethical business practices.

It’s the stuff movies are made of. The villain turned whistle-blower, Angelo Agrizzi has named and shamed lists and lists of dodgy players in the Bosasa looting game. He blames it all on CEO Gavin Watson – but tax consultant Peet Venter claims Agrizzi is not the so-called hero he appears to be – Venter fingers Agrizzi as a greedy businessman who didn’t get his way and is out to cripple Bosasa.

We tell the stories of two rogues pitted against each other in a tale of deception, manipulation and corruption.

HOW WE DO IT
- We start with a recap of the revelations
- We intro Agrizzi as the corrupted whistle-blower claiming to make it right
- We bring in Venter who aims to discredit Agrizzi
- We let the duel play out – with explosive scoops backed up by evidence

HELP NEEDED
- I"ll need Sinekitiwe to help me get Right of Replies from the politicians
- I'll need help sourcing the NEWS24 footage of the commission testimony that doesn't have their massive straps all over it.

Press Release:


Bosasa
Explosive testimony at the Zondo Commission on State Capture has lifted the lid on gross corruption and bribery, lining the palms of influential politicians and the blocking of police investigations, while filling the coffers of Bosasa. Carte Blanche speaks to the man who’s laid the rot bare – Angelo Agrizzi.
Producer: Nicky Troll
Presenter: Devi Sankaree Govender


Script:


VO: For South Africans, the Zondo Commission tasked to investigate State Capture was synomous with former President Jacob Zuma and his infamous cronies - the Guptas.

But two weeks of new explosive testimony has changed that perception, leaving the country reeling - revelation, after revelation.

RALPH: COrruption has been democratised // it is just multiple groups making their own beat to compete and steal from South Africans

LINK Gross corruption & bribery lining the palms of influential politicians delivered lucrative tenders worth billions to the Bosasa Group, now African Global Operations. The trail of questionable business practices has cast to a new set of villians in the state capture saga.

VO: At the centre of the billion rand business is CEO - Gavin Watson – an anti-apartheid struggle figure with close links to the ANC and former COO – corruptor turned whistlblower, Angelo Agrizzi.

A - I never corrupted anybody… I was a facilitator…yes // I betrayed myself, my family – the people looked up to – should have done it 20 years

VO: In an exclusive interview, Former Bosasa COO Angelo Agrizzi opens up about the entangled web of corruption and deceit he says he was a part of for almost two decades.

D - why so long
A - fear number 1
d- you kept quiet because never the right time to say anything shoot in foot 09.00
a - you’re correct – stay in comfort zone – trap of corruption of SA today.

VO: The company develops innovative service solutions across a range of sectors from security and catering to IT – making a killing from government contracts – raking in at least R2.8 billion over the past 10 years.

d – anything legit
a – salaries and wages paid on time
d – that’s it?
A – that’s all – there’s nothing that’s legitimate – all smokes and mirrors 09.22

VO: Agrizzi’s naming and shaming the alleged corrupted – the list is long including Dudu Myeni, Nomvula Mokonyane, Nomgcobo Jiba, members of parliament; senior correctional services officials and former President Jacob Zuma.

Agrizzi alleges that bribe money was packed in Bosasa’s vaults. This video shows Bosasa CEO, Gavin Watson and Chairman, Joe Gumede inside.

UPSOUND CLIP “…. eight…nine.. A million exactly…”

A - you got keep paying people, you’d have people calling up Gavin, I want this, I want this…
d – what would they want
a – generator, daughter coming // if you don’t do it this person is going to they will be anti us

VO: The alleged bribery extended to paid holidays, security systems, home renovations and even Christmas Groceries ranging from booze to frozen chicken and braai packs.

While it reads like a mafia movie filled with complex graft, collusion and compromise, political analyst Ralph Mathekga believes this is not all fiction.

RALPH: of course there might be exaggeration on the margins // but I do believe it is true. INT1 M7 begin // you could not script that –

VO: Bosasa’s Gavin Watson and Joe Gumede declined to be interviewed, Nomvula Mokonyane responded saying she shall await her opportunity to make representations at the Commission and is committed to participating fully. The other implicated parties in this story have not responded.

But Agrizzi’s testimony triggered one man’s decision to step out of the shadows and break his silence - Peet Venter is the lesser-known former Bosasa tax consultant Agrizzi mentioned.

PEET: at the State Capture Commission when he sat there and played the good guy INT1 M9 // I don’t believe everything he has said there – and that is why I have decided to talk. INT1 M10

VO: Agrizzi testified that Venter cooperated with him in making full disclosure of unlawful activities at Bosasa and referred to Venter’s affidavit.

PEET: // I signed the document under duress // due to the fact that they intimidated me and, and they blackmailed me that they would destroy me. INT2 M7.// Agrizzi is a very powerful person.

VO: In December 2017, Venter says he was called to Agrizzi’s house and former Bosasa CFO Andries van Tonder, who also testified at the commission, was there.

PEET: // they showed me Mr. Andries van TOnder’s statement and they asked me to do a similar statement – I had to type my personal details and then they would dictate to me what I should put in this statement. //INT1 M12

VO: An allegation Agrizzi denies. // Agrizzi and Van Tonder deny this.

a – I did not tell him, he wrote what he had to write did I provide him the mast, the overview
d – he copied it
a – yes – I didn’t tell him what to write

VO: Venter showed us both his and Van Tonder’s statements - there are sections that are identical – word for word.

DEVI: point is you signed that affidavit? INT2 M7
PEET: They did the renovation at my home many years ago, he used that against me. And it seems like he’s keeping record of everything, and also, me being involved in the company more than just a tax consultant because I was there every day. He used that against me. INT3 M23

a- let’s not debate who wrote your affidavit - come to the commission tell the truth 09.49

VO: Venter is more than willing to testify and cooperate.

As a company, Bosasa has been known to fight back when under fire.

LINK: // the corruption goes beyond just dishing out cash and gifts… Bosasa seemingly managed to block the Special Investigations Unit case that would out the group’s alleged corrupt relationship with Correction Services officials

VO: They even allegedly destroyed evidence.

d – who said destroy it
a – Gavin Watson
d – and you did it
a – the it guys did, papers I destroyed – with AVT we did – we burnt it //
d – struck by your honesty –
a – I destroyed evidence
D- That’s criminal //

VO: To this day, the case has not made it to court. The time to act is now explains Mathekga.

RALPH: you should be having action from the police in parallel to the commission. INT1 M12 // if we do not do something while commissions are under way they tend to be used by the perpetrators to recalibrate their defence strategy //.INT1 M14

LINK: // when there is this level of dirt is being dished up, detractors will come out of the shadows fast and ferociously. Agrizzi has come under fire for a racist rant recorded last year - now raising questions about his credibility.

VO: The recording was made in August last year at Agrizzi home during a meeting with Gavin Watson’s daughter Lindsay, and his nephew Jared. They are discussing the relationship between Watson and black directors at Bosasa.

UPSOUND AA RECORDING M6 [folder audio take over]
AA: Do you think for a minute your that your father has been put under pressure by the darkies?
JW: I’ll tell you exactly what he said at my place.
AA: DO you believe that?
JW: He said, he said they came to him and they said – “Your mess” – they’ve got, they’ve even approached an attorney as a collective…
AA: No! F*@ken hell
JW: I promise you, you’ll hear…
AA: Which attorney?
JW: He’ll tell you um…
AA: you know what I’ll go into that company, I will personally go into that company, with or without permission, and I’ll f*@k each of those K*ffirs out there.

D - you’re a racist –
A – I admitted I was a racist
D - what were you thinking
a – not gonna lie… why was it taken…
d- couldn’t argue that
a – you’re right the issue for me is it’s a commission on state capture, obviously people exposed will say ulterior motives // I was angry
d – default k- bomb
a – I should never have done it.

VO: Venter alleges that Agrizzi is not being honest about his motives – he claims there’s more to it than simply clearing a conscience.

PEET: The plan was to either take over the company or if they cant get that right to sabotage – destroy the company. INT2 M3 //

VO: Venter claims he was presented with this flow chart, detailing the way forward.

A – I did not touch that, I didn’t alter it, I did not do anything to that..
D – so these guys are lying
A – …leave up to you and judge zondo

VO: Mathekga cautions that South Africa should not be swayed by sub-plots.

RALPH: the allegation that Agrizzi’s motives are this, he is disgruntle – that should be understood as a fightback mechanism from those that are implicated - INT1 M10

VO: The reality is there aren’t many innocent parties in this tale, everyone appears to be dirty.

A – you know how nelson mandela and everybody sorted out the politics in the country right in the beginning with the TRC, and if you told the truth nothing will happen to you I’m saying do that – do that for the country

RALPH: //They deliberately did what they did – so the whole idea where they will come and it will be a festival of confessions and people will just walk away – that should not be the case// INT1 M17 // the legacy of this will remain with us. // the criminal justice system has been annihilated – irrespective of what we do about this . INT1 M3




PROMOS
PROMO 1
VO: After several days of explosive state capture testimony exposing corruption and bribery at Bosasa, we speak to corruptor turned whistleblower Angelo Agrizzi.

PROMO 2
VO: With dodgy deals, cash bribes and blocked police investigations exposed at the Zondo Commission – Bosasa’s unethical business practices tells a tale of many corrupted players.

Angelo – there’s nothing that’s legitimate – all smokes and mirrors 09.22

PROMO 3
VO: There are new villians in the State Capture Saga – the Bosasa Group are now at the centre of alledged gross corruption and bribery claims linked to influential politicians.

RALPH: // the criminal justice system has been annihilated – irrespective of what we do about this, the legacy of this will remain with us. // .
